From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Fijian

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

tavola

  1. Indian almond or tropical almond, Terminalia catappa.
    Synonyms: dalice, tivi

References

[edit]
  • Gatty, Ronald (2009), “tavola”, in Fijian-English Dictionary, Suva, Fiji: Ronald Gatty, →ISBN, page 262

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin tabula. Doublet of tabula and tavolo.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈta.vo.la/
  • Audio (una tavola):(file)
  • Rhymes: -avola
  • Hyphenation: tà‧vo‧la

Noun

[edit]

tavola f (plural tavole, diminutive tavolèlla or tavolétta or tavolettina or tavolina, augmentative tavolóna, pejorative tavolàccia or tavolùccia)

  1. (furniture) table
    Synonym: tavolo
  2. table (grid of data)
    Synonym: tabella
  3. board, panel, plank, slab (thin piece of wood or other material)
    Synonyms: asse, lastra, pannello
  4. plate (illustration)
  5. (art) painting
